status_note: The record follows the July 26, 2016 ordinance (Pipestone County Zoning Ordinance 7-26-16.pdf, also read), which put Large Solar Energy Systems at least 150 feet from a dwelling other than the project owner's. A 2017 amendment raised that to 400 feet from a non-participating occupied dwelling: the standalone Solar Ordinance PDF (amendments listed through October 24, 2017) and the full ordinance amended through January 9, 2018 both carry 400 feet. The two 2017 amendment dates on the page are June 13 and October 24, and the documents do not say which one changed the setback. The district table, with large systems barred from Rural Residential, Floodplain and Shoreland, is unchanged. Solar siting is therefore still restricted, but under the amended 400 foot setback, not the record's 150 feet. The posted copy carries no later amendment date. Board of Commissioners minutes posted for 2019 through 2026 (about 280 files) were searched for solar, zoning ordinance and moratorium.
